text: Sec. McGrane We’ve seen huge turnout for early voting and absentee voting. What’s the latest? What are the factors? Does this mean we’ll likely to see an overall turnout increase, or are these folks who might have voted on Tuesday anyway and are just showing up early? What is your office doing to ensure that ballot boxes are safe, after 3 states have seen people set fire to ballot boxes? What can voters do if they’re concerned about dropping a ballot in a box? (Go inside, obvi, but maybe have him say it instead of us) Have you had any concerns or threats about disruptions to safe and fair elections?
